hits.draft_en:
Vitol's CEO says oil demand will take a full year to get back to 2025 levels. The oil shock has already done the demand destruction the Fed would otherwise have to engineer.

That is how a rolling recession works its way through the economy.

narrative_synthesis: 173 originals cleared 5k views (~15.8M views combined); pulls capped at the 25 most recent posts for zerohedge, financialjuice, FirstSquawk and unusual_whales. The top two posts were Kobeissi's Axios report that Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike Iran right after Tuesday's midterm (1.34M) and unusual_whales on Claude blocking game cloning (1.26M). Iran dominated volume (~3.9M views), but housing data had the best medians: Canada's 20.5% price drop vs the US 2008 bust hit 874K. This morning's turn is de-escalation: Rubio's 'diplomatically' line pushed WTI below $100 (242K on Kobeissi) and Vitol's CEO said demand needs a year to recover. Sourced-stat posts and BREAKING leads beat raw wire flashes by about 5x on median views.
